literal_meaning: ঝাড় বা জঙ্গলের বাঁশ (bamboo from the thicket or jungle)
figurative_meaning_en: People of the same nature or kind
example_sentences_in_bangla: ওরা ঝাড়ের বাঁশ, কখনো একে অপরকে ছেড়ে যায় না।
সমপ্রকৃতির লোকেরা ঝাড়ের বাঁশের মতো একসঙ্গে থাকে।
example_sentences_in_english: They are like jharer bansh, never leaving each other's side.
People of the same nature stick together like bamboos in the thicket.
history: Derived from the proverb 'ঝাড়ের বাঁশ পড়ে না', which illustrates the natural solidarity of bamboos in a thicket that do not fall easily, symbolizing unity among similar people in Bengali folk tradition.
note: This idiom draws from rural observations of nature, emphasizing communal bonds.
